title: Large language models for mental health diagnosis and treatment: a survey
core_idea: A systematic review of how large language models can be applied to mental health to support early detection, personalized interventions, and public education, while analyzing capabilities, limitations, and implementation challenges such as model bias, privacy, reinforcement learning application, and clinical validation.
tldr: Survey of applications and challenges of large language models in mental health, focusing on early diagnosis, personalized treatment, education, and practical barriers to safe, equitable deployment.
